report.body:
Delivered projects/after-plan-recovery-replacement-for-human-abandoned-pm-263-r/20261026111255_after_plan_recovery.md, mono-v2-contracts.json, research.md (rep-5165 verbatim), and admission.json. Proposal title: After Plan Recovery. dec-57246 admitted four tasks with all weights 1, SWE p50 2443.905721s from 35 samples (7 legacy excluded), estimate 9775.622884s, critical path 1→2→4 at 7331.717163s, ceiling 21600s, max_live_runs_per_plan=1. No chaining needed. No task ids are seeded yet at this drafting revision; normal approval owns that.

Preserved every verification item, QA-required flag, interface, acceptance criterion and dependency from pinned 406f07877e618a90b3270a53356e5036b591933f. Explicitly retained all 24 TestPM263AfterPlan_ groups, twelve new drill cases, platform_shadow_to_live, both newer watchdog groups, the proof client's platform counter ==2, and observeStageTiming. Corrected the archived pm-263 commit-prefix sentence to assigned pm-267/<task_id>:. Existing-stack bug fix: no new library, external API, screen, migration, paid provider or human planning gate. Settings refreshed; current cap 5 and per-plan runs 1 preserved.

Validation before commit/push: pinned-contract comparison, exact groups/cases and fixture references, checkout-only required verification and timeout budgets, stable DAG, verbatim research equality and git diff --check all passed. No service code changed. Both focused commits use pm-267/run-8863: subjects. Safe push exited 0 on attempt 1, branch main, final SHA 2c4b5cae88931b5ea18bd7405316104f44d3e445; proposal source SHA 67882dcd8fc7a8b99a0a7e4acbc41571c61e1481 is included in its history. Pipeline https://gitlab.com/kq.viet/mono-v2/-/pipelines/2989351629 is skipped with zero bridges and manual-only jobs; no rollout for documentation artifacts.

Boundaries: planning integration delivered; changed service execution and product recovery not yet demonstrated. QA/acceptance must independently exercise HTTP and MCP default drills on the build containing T4 and preceding fixes, with exact cases/counts/notes, negative controls, cleanup and real-store observations. Fake launcher results do not prove real SWE execution. Historical defect build f19db8db is insufficient. pm-260 acceptance retains fresh pm-255 scheduler reconciliation, genuine dec-55805/dec-55807 release receipt, and t-1557 durable dispatch; this proposal does not mutate or gate on those plans, resume them, change caps, or touch completed t-1593. Prior research's otohime archive availability remains unverified and nonblocking. No runtime history scan or deployed recovery claim is made in this PO run.

Actual board run profile is codex-sol-6-1-high, run-8863, fleet avietidol-z490, account codex-main. Decisions recorded throughout; lessons include replacement commit identity versus immutable proof names, and exposed propose_tasks schema requiring objects despite its string-array declaration. Summary completes this product-owner handoff only.
